cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Be my raffle deputy. Match each ticket to its payment before you tear it off; I need one consistent system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why deputy? I can run a raffle myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll appreciate a single controller. You issue tickets; I approve refunds and corrections.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone's bought five and wants a discount. Can I decide that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring the five tickets to me, still attached. Your job is to preserve the decision until I make it. No improvising with the roll, please.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants coequal competence recognised and B4 seeks actual discount authority, giving an immediate role conflict.

heightening.evidence: A5 withholds the B4 decision but its practical ticket state is not securely established.

specificity.evidence: A1 raffle and B4 discount make the task concrete; bought versus attached needs clearer timing.
